description: Source code for cryptographic and random number generation functions, including environment and filesystem hashing, seed initialization, and session key processing, from the Stanford SRP Authentication Project.

methods.name: t_envhash
methods.description: Generates a SHA-1 hash of the environment variables.

methods.name: t_fshash
methods.description: Generates a SHA-1 hash based on filesystem state and current directory.

methods.name: t_initrand
methods.description: Initializes the seed for the random number generator using system entropy.

methods.name: t_random
methods.description: Generates cryptographically secure random bytes using SHA-1 feedback.

methods.name: t_sessionkey
methods.description: Creates an interleaved SHA-1 hash of the input key for session key derivation.
